description: Source code for RooHandler class implementing a provider for Roo Code Cloud API, including streaming chat completions, reasoning handling, model loading, and image generation.

classes.name: RooHandler
classes.description: A provider class for interfacing with Roo Code Cloud API, supporting streaming chat, reasoning, model management, and image generation.

methods.name: getSessionToken
methods.description: Retrieves the current session token from CloudService or returns 'unauthenticated'.

methods.name: createStream
methods.description: Creates a streaming chat completion request with Roo-specific parameters, handles reasoning, and processes streamed chunks.

methods.name: getReasoningDetails
methods.description: Returns accumulated reasoning details from the last streamed response.

methods.name: createMessage
methods.description: Generates a message stream with reasoning and tool call handling, managing streaming chunks and usage data.

methods.name: loadDynamicModels
methods.description: Loads and caches models dynamically from the Roo API.

methods.name: getModel
methods.description: Retrieves model information from cache or provides fallback defaults.

methods.name: generateImage
methods.description: Generates an image via Roo's image API, supporting different API methods and authentication.

methods.name: completePrompt
methods.description: Completes a prompt by updating API key and calling the superclass method.
